name: Torremocha de Jarama (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torremocha de Jarama (a tower on blue above waves and stars on blue).
history: Torremocha de Jarama adopted its arms and flag officially on 19 January 1989, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 11 February 1989; the flag is red with the arms of the town council at the centre.
